meta.name: pdf-processing-pro
meta.description: Production-ready PDF processing with forms, tables, OCR, validation, and batch operations. Use when working with complex PDF workflows in production environments, processing large volumes of PDFs, or requiring robust error handling and validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量处理PDF表单、表格、OCR和验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要自动化处理大量PDF文档
copy.tagline_en: Process PDF forms, tables, OCR, and validation in batch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to automate processing of large volumes of PDFs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 Python 脚本来处理 PDF：提取文本、表格、填写表单、合并拆分、OCR 识别等，并自动处理错误和验证。
howto.when: 当你需要处理 PDF 文件，例如提取表格、填写表单、合并或拆分 PDF，或者对扫描件进行 OCR 识别时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取这个PDF里的所有表格，保存为CSV。
用 data.json 的数据填写这个PDF表单，输出到 filled.pdf。
把这个PDF拆分成单页文件，放到 pages 文件夹。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run Python scripts to process PDFs: extract text, tables, fill forms, merge/split, OCR, with error handling and validation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to process PDF files, such as extracting tables, filling forms, merging/splitting PDFs, or OCR on scanned documents.

say_en.text: Extract all tables from this PDF and save as CSV.
Fill this PDF form with data from data.json and output to filled.pdf.
Split this PDF into single pages and save to pages folder.
